# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 80 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 80

**1** Jesus said: "Whoever has come to know the world has come upon a corpse — and whoever has come upon a corpse, the world is beneath them."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Come upon a corpse" — renders *sōma* (body) as the dead-body sense, aligning with Saying 56 (*ptōma*)
- "The world is beneath them" — "not worthy of" rendered as spatial-hierarchical inferiority
- PNEUMA sees Saying 80 as essentially identical in meaning to Saying 56 and renders accordingly
